body:
Source: whole-repo maintainability audit, 2026-09-20 (tools area). Decision already taken: the signed `--apply` write path STAYS; this ticket tidies it. Re-verified on main @ b2b5c6ea.

FACTS AT HEAD (all under packages/backlog-groom/).
1. Eight doc blocks are not attached to what they describe: lib/gate.mjs:71-83 (describes `ledgerApproves` at :129, sits on `entryBindsSlot` :84); lib/gate.mjs:312-323 (describes `buildActionArtifact` :338, stacked on `artifactName`'s block :324); lib/apply.mjs:23-30 (describes `actionsFromSet` :42, stacked on the `EXECUTABLE_ACTIONS` block :31); lib/cache.mjs:33 (describes `cacheKeyFor` :38, stacked on :34); lib/gh.mjs:14-16 (a bare `@param {{spawn}} io` block stacked on `issueSelector`'s block; it belongs to `makeGhWriter` :32, whose parameter is `{ spawn }`); lib/io.mjs:74-87 (says "The autonomy floor as it exists at the MERGE BASE" and `@returns {string[]|null}`, which is `baseFloorFromGit` :463 - that function carries only a one-liner - and it is stacked on `resolveRemoteBaseSha`'s block :88; `baseProfileFromGit` :168 has no doc block at all); lib/io.mjs:323-330 (describes `acquireApplyLock` :369, stacked on the `STALE_LOCK_MS` block :331); lib/usage.mjs:42 (describes `renderUsage` :46, stacked on the `COLUMN` block :43).
2. lib/gate.mjs: `entryBindsAction` (:98-113) restates the four comparisons of `entryBindsSlot` (:91-94); `ledgerApproves` (:129-144) restates `ledgerEntryFor` (:121-127); the sealed-entry object literal is written twice (:284 and :298-308, same key order); `buildActionArtifact` (:338-360) lists five `''` separator elements that the `.filter((l) => l !== '')` at :358 removes, so the artifact has never contained a blank line. `renderComment` (lib/execute.mjs:72-83) has the same shape with two `''` (:75, :77).
3. lib/ledger-sig.mjs:12-17 says `@adlc/gate-manifest`'s `exports` map is root-only. packages/gate-manifest/package.json has no `exports` key. The real reason the ledger has its own signer: gate-manifest `signEntry` signs the manifest's fixed field set (seq, gate, ts, ticket, data, files, prev) unless the entry declares `sigVersion: 2`, so a ledger entry canonicalises to `{}` and every entry would carry the same signature; it also has no domain prefix. Only the key variable (`ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY`) is shared.
4. `assertFloorNotWidened` / `assertFrozenPathsNotNarrowed` (lib/floor.mjs:114, :146) accept `authorized`; `applyRun` (lib/apply.mjs:235, :269, :271, :314) and `executeActions` (lib/execute.mjs:112, :116, :121) thread `floorWideningAuthorized` into it (`grep -ci authorized`: floor.mjs 6, apply.mjs 4, execute.mjs 3). The bin never passes it and NO test passes `floorWideningAuthorized`. The only uses are test/floor.test.mjs:125 and :211, which assert that the waiver works, and :134, which passes `authorized: false`.
5. `WRITE_ENTRY_POINTS` / `PURE_HELPERS` (lib/execute.mjs:27-39) are read only by test/floor.test.mjs:153-177. lib/execute.mjs:25 imports `verifyLedgerEntry` and never uses it.
6. `opError` is defined identically at lib/profile.mjs:45 and lib/floor.mjs:37. (bin/backlog-groom.mjs:57 `opError` is a different function: it prints, sets the exit code and throws a handled sentinel.) `canonicalJson` (lib/ledger-sig.mjs:36) and `canonical` (lib/floor.mjs:161) are the same function. `@adlc/core`'s `canonicalJson` is NOT byte-compatible: it drops undefined-valued keys and honours `toJSON`, where the local one writes `null` - `{a: undefined}` is `{"a":null}` locally and `{}` in core; a top-level `undefined` is `null` locally and the value `undefined` in core. Ledger signatures are computed over these bytes.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/backlog-groom`: `bin/backlog-groom.mjs` (CLI; read path by default, `--apply --set <file>` is the write path); `lib/gate.mjs` (one-shot review gate, ledger predicates, review artifact), `lib/ledger-sig.mjs` (HMAC over domain-prefixed canonical bytes), `lib/floor.mjs` (autonomy floor, merge-base policy comparison), `lib/execute.mjs` (comment-then-act, idempotent), `lib/apply.mjs` (assembles gate -> floor -> execute), `lib/io.mjs` (profile/cache/ledger/lock/git wiring), `lib/profile.mjs`, `lib/cache.mjs`, `lib/gh.mjs`, `lib/usage.mjs`; the read path (`classify`, `cluster`, `content-hash`, `emit`, `fetch`, `groom`, `rank`, `relabel`, `relations`, `report`, `verify`) is not part of this change. `lib/profile.mjs` and `lib/floor.mjs` have no imports today. Tests: `npm test -w packages/backlog-groom` from the worktree root. Test segments are globbed (`packages/<pkg>/test/*.test.mjs`) and `package.json` `files` already ships `lib/`, so new files need no registry edit. The only existing test file this change may edit is `test/floor.test.mjs`. Three repo-wide checks read this diff as text: `scripts/test/source-hygiene.test.mjs` refuses a raw control byte in any tracked `.mjs`/`.json` (so a NUL is always written as the two-character escape `\0`, never as the byte); `scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` refuses a new test file that mints a temp directory; `scripts/check-reviewer-directed-comments.mjs` scans every comment block the diff touches.

NORMATIVE DECISIONS.
0. Nothing observable through the CLI changes: flags, exit codes, stdout/stderr text, every error-message string, the review-artifact bytes and `artifactDigest`, the ledger signature bytes, the key order of a recorded ledger entry, and the GitHub comment body are all byte-identical. The library surface narrows in exactly three places and nowhere else: the `authorized` option, the `floorWideningAuthorized` option, and the `WRITE_ENTRY_POINTS` / `PURE_HELPERS` exports (decisions 8 and 9). No dependency is added; `package.json` is not edited.
1. Characterise first. Create `packages/backlog-groom/test/tidy-contract.test.mjs` - pure and in-memory: no temp directories, no child processes; source files are read with `readFileSync` relative to `import.meta.url`. Every test is a top-level `test('<prefix>: ...', ...)` call whose name starts with one of exactly five prefixes: `golden:`, `docs:`, `structure:`, `waiver:`, `helpers:`. The file statically imports only modules that exist on main (`gate`, `ledger-sig`, `execute`, `floor`, `apply`); `lib/canonical-json.mjs` and `lib/op-error.mjs` are loaded with `await import(...)` inside the `helpers:` tests, so the `golden:` tests stay runnable against main's `lib/` at every commit. Tests named `golden:` pass on unmodified main and must still pass at the end; the first commit that touches `packages/backlog-groom` adds only this file, containing only them. With `KEY = 'k'.repeat(32)`, `CLOSE = { number: 705, action: 'close', contentHash: 'c0ffee', evidence: 'lib/a.mjs:2 no longer contains the cited line' }`, `RELABEL = { number: 7, action: 'relabel', field: 'priority', from: 'P3-low', to: 'P2-medium', contentHash: 'abc', evidence: 'ev' }` they pin:
   - `buildActionArtifact(CLOSE)` is exactly these nine lines joined by `\n`, with no blank line: `# Proposed close — issue #705` / `- issue: #705` / `- action: close` / `- revision (contentHash): c0ffee` / `## Evidence` / `lib/a.mjs:2 no longer contains the cited line` / `## What is being asked` / `Is this close justified by the evidence above, for this issue, at this revision?` / `A material objection means the action is demoted to a proposal for a human.`; `buildActionArtifact(RELABEL)` is the same shape with `- field: priority`, `- from: P3-low`, `- to: P2-medium` after the revision line.
   - `artifactDigest(CLOSE) === '6fe3dd4012c36b00c02d746012880747fe8b6f1b82ce40325ff8e3c9a09b4d81'`; `artifactDigest(RELABEL) === '0ce06d9b3e66388912443c2bbce435fda0875ff58b2238daad16418a2734a6ea'`; `artifactDigest({ number: 9, action: 'close', contentHash: 'h', evidence: { a: 1, b: [2] } }) === '688bf98854b1eb0af2442d958271b97b46f519eb5975c4de144f37584d675fb0'`; the same action with `evidence: ''` gives `'cbf08985fa43761f9856c7ea88ce1b670dd7fb73ec64da1796a8645dceabf406'`.
   - `signLedgerEntry(KEY, { verdict: 'approve', reason: null, reviewer: 'rev', decider: 'dec', contentHash: 'c0ffee', number: 705, action: 'close', field: null, artifactDigest: artifactDigest(CLOSE) }) === '937aa5cb94d71cc4d9462dd2692e54c1cdfa64bb9422720440a3df3f4024bf7a'`.
   - `gateAction({ action: CLOSE, profile: { providers: { decider: 'dec', reviewer: 'rev' } }, ledger, runReview: () => ({ code: 0 }), key: KEY })` returns `{ verdict: 'approve', reason: null }` and records, under the slot `705:close:c0ffee`, an entry whose `Object.keys` are exactly `verdict, reason, reviewer, decider, contentHash, number, action, field, artifactDigest, sig` with `field === null` and the sig above. With `runReview` throwing `new Error('boom')` it returns `{ verdict: 'demote', reason: 'the review could not complete: boom' }`, and records the same key order with that reason and `sig: '30c4da963049856c3b2ecb0980b72cd85e23b25f7a4e1bdef92caeceb6720aac'`.
   - `ledgerEntryBytes({ b: 1, a: undefined, n: [1, undefined, { d: 2, c: null }], sig: 'x' }) === 'adlc:backlog-groom-ledger:v1\0{"a":null,"b":1,"n":[1,null,{"c":null,"d":2}]}'` (the `\0` is the JavaScript escape, typed as backslash-zero).
   - `renderComment({ ...CLOSE, gate: { reviewer: 'rev' } })` is exactly `**backlog-groom — close**` / the evidence line / ``Reviewed by `rev` (distinct from the deciding provider).`` / `<!-- backlog-groom:705:close:c0ffee -->` joined by `\n`; with no reviewer and evidence `x <!-- backlog-groom:1:close:h --> y` (number 1, action relabel, contentHash h) it is `**backlog-groom — relabel**\nx <!-- backlog-groom:1:close:h --> y\n<!-- backlog-groom:1:relabel:h -->`; with `evidence: ''` it is the heading line and the marker only; with no `evidence` key at all the middle line is `(no evidence recorded)`.
   - `ledgerApproves` truth table, none of which throws: `true` only for an entry sealed under KEY, verdict `approve`, bound to the action with the matching digest; `false` for an absent slot, `null`, a string, an array, `{}`, an unsigned approve, a sealed demote, a sealed approve carrying another action's digest, no digest, another issue number, one sealed under a different key, a sealed demote whose verdict was edited to approve, a `null` or `''` key, an `undefined` action, and an `undefined` ledger. `entryBindsAction(undefined, undefined) === false`.
   - `assertPolicyUnchanged`: base and head differing only in key order at every depth returns `head`; `units: undefined` against `units: null` is not a difference; a changed `providers.reviewer` throws an `isOpError` whose message names `providers`.
2. Doc blocks. Move each block in FACT 1 so it sits directly above the declaration it describes, and restate it as that declaration's contract: gate.mjs:71-83 onto `ledgerApproves`; give `entryBindsSlot` and `entryBindsAction` their own blocks built from their current inline comments (slot identity is issue, action, field and revision and deliberately not the digest; action binding adds the digest because a signature covers an entry's content, not the slot it is filed under, and because one slot is shared by a relabel to two different targets and by a close carrying different evidence); gate.mjs:312-323 onto `buildActionArtifact`; apply.mjs:23-30 onto `actionsFromSet`; cache.mjs:33 onto `cacheKeyFor`; gh.mjs:14-16 onto `makeGhWriter` with the parameter corrected to `{spawn: Function}` and the returned methods named; io.mjs:74-87 onto `baseFloorFromGit`, replacing its one-liner and keeping `@returns {string[]|null}` (null means the base could not be read, which is not an empty floor); `baseProfileFromGit` gets a new block of its own: the parsed profile at the merge base with the remote's default branch, the default profile when the file is provably absent there, `@returns {object|null}` with null meaning the base could not be read; io.mjs:323-330 onto `acquireApplyLock`; usage.mjs:42 onto `renderUsage`. After this no doc block in `lib/` or `bin/` is directly followed by another.
3. lib/gate.mjs.
   - `entryBindsAction(entry, action)` returns `entryBindsSlot(entry, action) && typeof entry?.artifactDigest === 'string' && entry.artifactDigest === artifactDigest(action)`. The `typeof` guard stays: it is what makes `(undefined, undefined)` return `false` instead of throwing. Keep the two digest lines byte-identical to today's.
   - `ledgerApproves(ledger, action, key = null)` returns `ledgerEntryFor(ledger, action, key)?.verdict === 'approve'`. This is the same result for every input on which `artifactDigest(action)` does not throw. Only evaluation order changes: the verdict is compared after the signature and the binding, so an action whose evidence cannot be JSON-serialised now throws for a verified non-approve entry as it already does for an approve entry - and `executeActions` already evaluates `ledgerEntryFor` for the same arguments before `planAction` runs, so the pipeline is unchanged. State this in the PR description.
   - `gateAction` builds the sealed entry in ONE place: a single inner helper that assigns `ledger[slot] = sealLedgerEntry(key, { verdict, reason, reviewer, decider, contentHash, number, action, field, artifactDigest })` in exactly that key order (the ledger file is written in insertion order) and returns `{ verdict, reason }`; the reviewer-threw path and the verdict path both use it.
   - The comment above the one-shot check (:243-266) becomes: `// One shot per slot: a verified, slot-bound entry (approve OR demote) refuses a` / `// second review. Not bound to artifactDigest, so rewording cannot buy a re-roll.` / `// An unverifiable or relocated entry is not a record of a review: overwrite it.`
   - The module header (:1-21) is not edited.
4. Dead separators. Delete the five `''` elements in `buildActionArtifact` and the two in `renderComment`. Keep both `.filter((l) => l !== '')` calls: they still drop the absent `field`/`from`/`to` lines, an empty evidence string, and the absent reviewer line. Do NOT restore the blank lines - that changes `artifactDigest` for every action and invalidates every approval an adopter has recorded.
5. lib/ledger-sig.mjs header: replace the paragraph at :12-17 with the true reason from FACT 3 (own signer because gate-manifest's `signEntry` signs the manifest's fixed field set, so a ledger entry would sign as `{}`, and it has no domain prefix; same key variable, different bytes). Do not import `@adlc/gate-manifest`.
6. One canonical serialiser. New `lib/canonical-json.mjs` exports `canonicalJson(value)` with the body `lib/ledger-sig.mjs` has today; `lib/ledger-sig.mjs` and `lib/floor.mjs` import it and their local copies are deleted. Its doc block states the contract: object keys sorted at every depth; `undefined` (top level, object value, array element) is written as `null`; NOT interchangeable with `@adlc/core`'s `canonicalJson`, which drops undefined-valued keys; the output is signed, so the format is frozen. The new test pins `canonicalJson` directly: `undefined` -> `null`, `null` -> `null`, `'x'` -> `"x"`, `7` -> `7`, `true` -> `true`, `[1,[2,undefined,null]]` -> `[1,[2,null,null]]`, `{b:1,a:2}` -> `{"a":2,"b":1}`, `{a:undefined}` -> `{"a":null}`, `{z:{y:[{b:1,a:undefined}]}}` -> `{"z":{"y":[{"a":null,"b":1}]}}`.
7. One tagged-error helper. New `lib/op-error.mjs` exports `opError(message)` returning `Object.assign(new Error(message), { isOpError: true })`; `lib/profile.mjs` and `lib/floor.mjs` import it and delete their copies. The inline `Object.assign(new Error(...), { isOpError: true })` sites in apply.mjs, execute.mjs, io.mjs and usage.mjs, and the bin's own `opError`, are left exactly as they are.
8. Remove the waiver. `assertFloorNotWidened({ base, head })` and `assertFrozenPathsNotNarrowed({ base, head })` take no `authorized`; `applyRun` and `executeActions` take no `floorWideningAuthorized` (the `@param` line at lib/execute.mjs:112 goes too). A caller that still passes either key is ignored and the widening is refused. The doc block on `assertFloorNotWidened` says: compared against the base because the working copy is what someone widening the floor controls; there is no waiver - no flag, no option, no profile key; the path to a wider floor is landing the profile change on the default branch, after which the base carries it. Message strings are unchanged. In `test/floor.test.mjs` delete the tests at :124-126 and :210-212 and drop `authorized: false` at :134.
9. Export classification moves to its only reader. Delete `WRITE_ENTRY_POINTS` and `PURE_HELPERS` from `lib/execute.mjs`; declare the same two lists as constants in `test/floor.test.mjs`; the two AC6 tests keep their names, and the structural one asserts BOTH directions (every exported function of execute.mjs is declared; every declared name is an exported function). Remove the unused `verifyLedgerEntry` import at lib/execute.mjs:25.
10. Injection seams stay. Every `io` / `run` parameter in lib is exercised by the existing tests (fake git, fake gh, unreadable and unwritable files, lock races); none is removed here.
11. Comments. Every block touched states the contract - what it returns or refuses and what a caller may rely on - in the present tense, with no narrative of earlier versions. Blocks not named in this ticket are not rewritten.
12. Documentation: none. README.md, docs/tools/backlog-groom.md, apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/backlog-groom.mdx and the skill describe none of these internals and the CLI is unchanged.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 The characterisation tests pass on unmodified main (first commit) and at the branch tip, and every prefix selects at least one test (a name pattern that matches nothing exits 0). verify: `node --test --test-name-pattern='^golden:' packages/backlog-groom/test/tidy-contract.test.mjs`; `for p in golden docs structure waiver helpers; do grep -c "^test(.$p: " packages/backlog-groom/test/tidy-contract.test.mjs; done` (each >= 1); `git log --reverse --format=%H origin/main..HEAD -- packages/backlog-groom | head -1 | xargs -I{} git show --name-only --format= {} -- packages/backlog-groom` prints only `packages/backlog-groom/test/tidy-contract.test.mjs`
- AC2 No doc block in lib/ or bin/ is directly followed by another (7 on main), and `ledgerApproves`, `entryBindsSlot`, `entryBindsAction`, `buildActionArtifact`, `actionsFromSet`, `cacheKeyFor`, `makeGhWriter`, `baseProfileFromGit`, `baseFloorFromGit`, `acquireApplyLock`, `renderUsage` are each immediately preceded by a doc block. verify: `node --test --test-name-pattern='^docs:' packages/backlog-groom/test/tidy-contract.test.mjs`
- AC3 gate.mjs states each thing once: exactly one `sealLedgerEntry(` and exactly one `entry?.contentHash` in lib/gate.mjs (main: 2 and 2); no line that is only `'',` in lib/gate.mjs or lib/execute.mjs (main: 5 and 2); `verifyLedgerEntry` does not appear in lib/execute.mjs (main: 1). verify: `node --test --test-name-pattern='^structure:' packages/backlog-groom/test/tidy-contract.test.mjs`
- AC4 The waiver is gone: `assertFloorNotWidened({ base: ['close'], head: [], authorized: true })` and `assertFrozenPathsNotNarrowed({ base: ['a/**'], head: [], authorized: true })` throw `isOpError`; `applyRun` with `set: { issues: [] }`, a `basePolicy` equal to the profile, `baseFloor: ['close']`, `profile.autonomyFloor: []` and `floorWideningAuthorized: true` throws the WIDER error; `executeActions({ actions: [], floor: [], baseFloor: ['close'], floorWideningAuthorized: true })` throws it too (all four return normally on main). verify: `node --test --test-name-pattern='^waiver:' packages/backlog-groom/test/tidy-contract.test.mjs` and `grep -ci authorized packages/backlog-groom/lib/floor.mjs packages/backlog-groom/lib/apply.mjs packages/backlog-groom/lib/execute.mjs` (each 0; main: 6, 4, 3 - the `-i` matters, `floorWideningAuthorized` has a capital A)
- AC5 One serialiser and one tagged-error helper: `lib/canonical-json.mjs` passes the byte pins in decision 6; `opError('m')` is an `Error` with message `m` and `isOpError === true`; across lib/*.mjs there is exactly one `function canonicalJson` and no `function canonical(`, and exactly one `function opError`; every export of lib/execute.mjs is a function. verify: `node --test --test-name-pattern='^helpers:' packages/backlog-groom/test/tidy-contract.test.mjs`
- AC6 The false claim and the history narrative are gone. verify: `grep -rcE 'root-only|were drifting|had already drifted|LIBRARY seam|SIGNED, but NOT bound' packages/backlog-groom/lib` (every file 0; main: ledger-sig.mjs 1, floor.mjs 1, gate.mjs 3)
- AC7 Existing suite green, and the only existing test file edited is floor.test.mjs. verify: `npm test -w packages/backlog-groom` and `git diff --name-only origin/main -- packages/backlog-groom/test` (exactly `floor.test.mjs` and `tidy-contract.test.mjs`)
- AC8 Nothing outside lib/ and test/ changes, so no dependency, lockfile or docs edit. verify: `git diff --name-only origin/main -- . ':!.adlc' | grep -v '^packages/backlog-groom/\(lib\|test\)/'` prints nothing
- AC9 The change is not trust-root tier. verify: `node packages/prosecute/bin/adlc-prosecute.mjs tier-check --base origin/main` prints `NOT trust-root tier`
- AC10 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally)
- AC11 The repo-wide text checks that read this diff stay green. verify: `node scripts/check-reviewer-directed-comments.mjs origin/main` exits 0 and `node --test scripts/test/source-hygiene.test.mjs scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs`

OUT OF SCOPE: restoring blank lines in the review artifact or the GitHub comment (changes `artifactDigest`; needs a versioned digest); adopting `@adlc/core`'s `canonicalJson` or `@adlc/gate-manifest`'s signer; converting the inline `isOpError` throw sites; the two `isPlainObject` copies; removing or reshaping any `io`/`run` injection parameter, including the never-passed `now` (io.mjs:361), `headCommit(run)`, the private `run` parameters in verify.mjs and content-hash.mjs, and `fetchIssues` `limit`; the apply lock implementation; `lib/usage.mjs` versus core usage synthesis; the bin; any message text; the read path; any documentation.
title: backlog-groom: tidy the write path with no CLI-observable change - attach orphaned docs, dedupe the gate predicates and local helpers, remove the floor-waiver seam
